title: Work, collaboration & problem-solving
description: Hand-selected conversational vocabulary with contextual Mandarin examples.

cards.english: Organization; work unit; unit of measure
Do; handle; get into a state (colloquial)
to explain; to illustrate; to indicate
to pass through; to get through; to adopt (a resolution); to pass (legislation); to pass (a test)
straight (in a straight line); continuously; always; all the way through
Know how to; will; be likely to
Again; then, for a future action
to appear; to arise; to emerge
to agree; to consent; to approve
to handle; to deal with; to punish; to treat sth by a special process; to process

grammar.markup: {大部分}{同事}{都}{同意}{这}{个}{计划}。
grammar.pinyin: Dà bù fen tóng shì dōu tóng yì zhè ge jì huà.
grammar.english: Most colleagues agree with this plan.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men zuì jìn de gōng zuò chéng jì bú cuò.
grammar.english: Our recent work results have been good.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de yǒu dào li.
grammar.english: What you're saying makes sense.

grammar.markup: {这}{次}{开会}{的}{目的}{是}{解决}{问题}。
grammar.pinyin: Zhè cì kāi huì de mù dì shì jiě jué wèn tí.
grammar.english: The purpose of this meeting is to solve problems.

grammar.pinyin: Tā tōng guò le kǎo shì.
grammar.english: He passed the exam.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí yī zhí chóng fù chū xiàn.
grammar.english: This problem keeps happening again.

grammar.markup: {我们}{需要}{多}{一些}{面对面}{的}{对话}。
grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào duō yī xiē miàn duì miàn de duì huà.
grammar.english: We need more face-to-face conversations.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào gǎi shàn yòng hù tǐ yàn.
grammar.english: We need to improve the user experience.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān shuì jiào zhī qián fù xí zhōng wén.
grammar.english: I review Chinese every day before bed.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men zhōng yú qǔ dé le hǎo chéng jì.
grammar.english: We finally achieved good results.

grammar.pinyin: Zhǐ yào jì xù nǔ lì, jiù huì jìn bù.
grammar.english: If you keep trying, you'll improve.

grammar.pinyin: Jīng lǐ zhèng zài kāi huì.
grammar.english: The manager is in a meeting.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ de lǐ xiǎng shì zuò yǒu yì yì de gōng zuò.
grammar.english: My ideal is to do meaningful work.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men yào tí gāo gōng zuò xiào lǜ.
grammar.english: We need to improve work efficiency.

grammar.markup: {这}{台}{计算机}{可以}{处理}{很多}{数据}。
grammar.pinyin: Zhè tái jì suàn jī kě yǐ chǔ lǐ hěn duō shù jù.
grammar.english: This computer can process a lot of data.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge fāng fǎ hái kě yǐ zài gǎi jìn.
grammar.english: This method can still be improved.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng nǐ de guān diǎn.
grammar.english: I'd like to hear your perspective.

grammar.pinyin: Dāng shí wǒ men hái méi yǒu jué dìng.
grammar.english: At that time, we hadn't decided yet.

grammar.pinyin: Tā zài lìng yī ge dān wèi gōng zuò.
grammar.english: He works at a different organization.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ qù qián tái qǔ dōng xi.
grammar.english: You can collect the item from reception.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge xiàng mù xū yào dà liàng de shù jù.
grammar.english: This project needs a large amount of data.

grammar.markup: {我们}{从}{数据}{中}{得出}{了}{这}{个}{结果}。
grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men cóng shù jù zhōng dé chū le zhè ge jié guǒ.
grammar.english: We arrived at this result from the data.

grammar.pinyin: Tā zhè cì kǎo shì de fēn shù hěn gāo.
grammar.english: His score on this exam is high.

grammar.pinyin: Jiào yù duì hái zi de wèi lái hěn zhòng yào.
grammar.english: Education is important for children's futures.

grammar.markup: {我们}{应该}{用}{科学}{的}{方法}{解决}{问题}。
grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi yòng kē xué de fāng fǎ jiě jué wèn tí.
grammar.english: We should solve problems using scientific methods.

grammar.pinyin: Tā dā ying míng tiān lái bāng máng.
grammar.english: He promised to come help tomorrow.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge dōng xi zěn me nòng?
grammar.english: How do you work this thing?

grammar.pinyin: Děng dào zhōu mò, wǒ men zài tǎo lùn.
grammar.english: Let's discuss it when the weekend comes.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè shì yī ge guó jì huì yì.
grammar.english: This is an international conference.

grammar.markup: {我们}{需要}{重新}{检查}{这}{个}{文件}。
grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào chóng xīn jiǎn chá zhè ge wén jiàn.
grammar.english: We need to check this file again.

grammar.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú shí xiàn le zì jǐ de mù biāo.
grammar.english: He finally achieved his goal.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng duō liàn xí kǒu yǔ.
grammar.english: I want to practice spoken Chinese more.

grammar.markup: {他}{大学}{毕业}{以后}{先}{实习}{了}{半年}。
grammar.pinyin: Tā dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu xiān shí xí le bàn nián.
grammar.english: After university he spent six months as an intern.

grammar.pinyin: Qǐng shuō míng yí xià nǐ de xiǎng fǎ.
grammar.english: Please explain your idea briefly.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè zhè yàng zuò duì dà jiā dōu gōng píng.
grammar.english: Doing it this way is fair to everyone.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men xū yào kǎo lǜ shí jì qíng kuàng.
grammar.english: We need to consider the actual situation.

grammar.pinyin: Tā zài shàng hǎi dǎ gōng hěn duō nián le.
grammar.english: He has worked for wages in Shanghai for many years.
